name: Gloamcat
summary: A dusk-gray panther whose shadow moves a half step ahead of the rest of it.
description: Gloamcats prowl where the forest is darkest, and they are said to step through the dusk the way others step through a door. The oldest woodsmen refuse to carry a lantern at twilight, which the cats seem to resent.

traits.name: Shadow Step
traits.text: While in Dim Light or Darkness, the cat can use a {ref:glossary/bonus-action} to teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space it can see that is also in Dim Light or Darkness.

traits.name: Light Sensitivity
traits.text: While in {ref:glossary/bright-light}, the cat has {ref:glossary/disadvantage} on attack rolls.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The cat makes two Claw attacks. It can replace one attack with a Bite attack.

actions.name: Bite
actions.onHit: and the target has the {ref:condition/grappled} condition (escape {dc:str}).
